title: Exploring the mechanism of fibrates regulating HIF-1A in the treatment of ischemic stroke based on network pharmacology and molecular docking.
authors: Yang, Fengjiao; Yang, Zixuan; Yan, Ya; Gu, Yun; Wang, Pengyu; Wang, Min; Chen, Jianjie; Du, Xiaoshan; Wang, Guangming
one_liner_zh: 该文用网络药理学和分子对接研究贝特类药物调控HIF-1A治疗缺血性卒中，虽涉及蛋白-小分子对接，但非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联度低。
abstract: Fibrates can prevent and treat ischemic stroke (IS), the occurrence and development of IS is closely related to hypoxia-inducible factor-1A (HIF-1A). However, the exact mechanism by which fibrates regulate HIF-1A to treat IS remains unclear. So network pharmacology and molecular docking were used to explore the mechanism by which fibrates regulate HIF-1A to treat IS, firstly, the structure of five fibrates were obtained by reviewing the literature and pharmacopoeia, then the potential targets of fibrates, IS, HIF1A and HIF1A-related genes were obtained through various databases, their common targets were obtained through Venny 2.1.0. The PPI network diagram of fibrates, IS and HIF1A-related genes was plotted by String and Cytoscape3.8.1. The GO functional analysis results and KEGG pathways of fibrates, IS, HIF1A and HIF1A related genes were obtained by Metascape. Finally, the molecular docking of fibrates and HIF1A was performed by AutoDock. The common targets of five fibrates and IS showed that only 3 fibrates contained HIF1A, GO functional analysis, KEGG pathway analysis and molecular docking showed that fibrates can better regulate HIF1A to treat IS, its main action pathways are pathways in cancer, lipid and atherosclerosis and HIF-1 signaling pathway.
abstract_zh: 贝特类药物可以预防和治疗缺血性脑卒中（IS），IS的发生和发展与缺氧诱导因子-1A（HIF-1A）密切相关。然而，贝特类药物调节HIF-1A治疗IS的确切机制仍不清楚。因此，采用网络药理学和分子对接技术探讨贝特类药物调节HIF-1A治疗IS的机制，首先，通过查阅文献和药典获得五种贝特类药物的结构，然后通过多个数据库获取贝特类药物、IS、HIF1A及HIF1A相关基因的潜在靶点，并通过Venny 2.1.0获得其共同靶点。利用String和Cytoscape3.8.1绘制贝特类药物、IS和HIF1A相关基因的PPI网络图。通过Metascape获得贝特类药物、IS、HIF1A及HIF1A相关基因的GO功能分析结果和KEGG通路。最后，利用AutoDock进行贝特类药物与HIF1A的分子对接。五种贝特类药物与IS的共同靶点显示，仅3种贝特类药物包含HIF1A，GO功能分析、KEGG通路分析和分子对接表明，贝特类药物能较好地调节HIF1A治疗IS，其主要作用通路为癌症通路、脂质与动脉粥样硬化通路及HIF-1信号通路。
